//: Production overrides for shared hosting (SmarterASP.NET). Non-secret settings only — connection string, JWT secret and Tawked key are set as environment variables in web.config. A JSON array replaces the one in appsettings.json rather than adding to it, which is why Cors is written out in full.

Api.//EnableSwagger: Off by default: building the API document costs memory a shared host does not have to spare, and it publishes a catalogue of every endpoint. Turn it on here, or set Api__EnableSwagger=true, when you want to read the reference.

//Redis: Redis is not offered on shared hosting. Turning it off selects the in-process lock, rate limiter and cache that DependencyInjection registers instead. That is correct for a single application pool and wrong the moment a second one exists — see the guide.

Database.//AutoMigrate: Kept on deliberately. Shared hosting recycles the application pool, so the application cannot be relied on to start exactly once and be patched from then on. Migrating on a cold start is a no-op against an already-migrated database, and the alternative is a site that silently stops applying schema changes after the first deployment.

Storage.//: Pictures are written into wwwroot/uploads, which persists on shared hosting as long as new files are uploaded without deleting the folder. Re-uploading the site with 'delete everything first' removes every uploaded cover image and product photograph.

//Payments: Free deposits are refused in Production by the code as well; false here says so.
//Paymob: The keys and integration ids are secrets and come from web.config. Paymob calls back to, and returns the customer to, the address the app reached the site on (dealgosa.com); set Paymob__CallbackBaseUrl only if that ever differs from the public address.
